criteria.description: Both multiply traces actually execute the one allowed MCP tool with alias1/alias2 and multiply, restore exactly51.00 locally, and final equals returned result alias.
Both date traces execute date_difference in issued start/end order, restore exactly4days locally, and final equals returned result alias.
